### Sample 1
Hello! I have read the task spec carefully and drafted a thorough implementation plan that respects the project's architectural constraints.
---
### Sample 2
The HookPort implementation ships eight Sherpa-managed hooks covering audit logging, token metrics, session timeline, context injection, language verification, gate enforcement, critical-zone warning, and cost warning.
---
### Sample 3
We use the temp + fsync + rename protocol for atomic writes to the settings file, which guarantees data integrity even when the process crashes mid-write.
---
### Sample 4
The merger tests verify that user-managed entries are preserved unchanged while Sherpa entries are replaced wholesale, satisfying the NF25 requirement.
---
### Sample 5
Parse errors are handled gracefully: when the settings file is missing or malformed, we start from a fresh structure and persist it atomically without dropping user data from other sections.
